hooks.command: root="$PWD"; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$root/.codex/hooks/memory_hook.py" ]; do root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; script="$root/.codex/hooks/memory_hook.py"; python3 -c 'import hashlib,os,sys;p=sys.argv[1];e=sys.argv[2];d=hashlib.sha256(open(p,chr(114)+chr(98)).read()).hexdigest();d==e or sys.exit(3);os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,p])' "$script" "d3f87d4b7d22662d5f9bc1ce794262e28f7b7be45ad3a2cf22f68e115fafb019"
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=(Get-Location).Path; while ($root -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/memory_hook.py'))) { $parent=Split-Path $root -Parent; if ($parent -eq $root) { break }; $root=$parent }; $script=Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/memory_hook.py'; py -3 -c 'import hashlib,os,sys;p=sys.argv[1];e=sys.argv[2];d=hashlib.sha256(open(p,chr(114)+chr(98)).read()).hexdigest();d==e or sys.exit(3);os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,p])' $script 'd3f87d4b7d22662d5f9bc1ce794262e28f7b7be45ad3a2cf22f68e115fafb019'"
